title: vat brain marker, schema 1
description: The .brain marker at the root of a brain repository. It names the brain's schema and may carry the lifecycle policy the brain runs under when no workspace manifest governs it. Normative prose is docs/SPEC.md section 5.1; where the two disagree, SPEC.md is the specification and this file has a bug. A reader reads the schema line line by line, so a marker that is not valid YAML still names its schema; this file describes only markers that are valid YAML.

schema.description: The brain's schema. A marker without it predates versioning and is read as schema 1.

policy.description: The lifecycle a standalone brain runs under. A key absent here takes its default. Where a workspace manifest governs the brain, the manifest's brain policy applies in full and this block is ignored. Unknown keys are refused: a typo would otherwise disable the rule it configures.

promotion_gate.description: How a provisional record becomes active. Default manual.

stale_after_days.description: When an observed current-state claim stops counting as verified. Default 90.

review_sla_days.description: How long a record may wait in a non-answerable state before the queue is reported as failing. Default 30.

require_promotion_gate.description: Whether a canonical record needs an explicit promotion step. Default true.

require_external_evidence.description: Whether a source_external record must carry source_url and source_quote. Default false, so records written before those fields existed keep passing.
